name: Weather
author: ViberDock
description: Current conditions and a forecast popup from Open-Meteo, with optional forecasts on the dock in several layouts (day cells, tinted day chips, a curve of the coming hours) and three icon packs, one of them animated. Choose a place for each widget or use the app's default place.

settings.label: Place
settings.description: The town or city whose weather is shown. Empty: the app's default place.

settings.label: Name on the dock
settings.description: Shown under the temperature (empty: none).

settings.label: Units
settings.description: Metric shows °C and km/h, imperial °F and mph. Default: metric.

settings.label: Refresh every
settings.description: How often a new forecast is fetched. Default: 30.

settings.label: Forecast on the dock

choices.label: Today's high and low (under the temperature)

settings.description: Several days: a cell per day after the current conditions, laid out by Layout below; the slot grows.

settings.label: Days on the dock
settings.description: How many days the forecast on the dock shows. Default: 3.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: A preset for the current conditions and the day cells, or Custom for the fields below. Default: automatic.

choices.label: Strip: a column per day beside the conditions
Tiles: day over icon, high and low beside them
List: a line per day under the conditions
Card: big conditions, tiles under them
Trend: the next hours as a curve
Capsules: a tinted chip per day

settings.label: Current conditions
settings.description: The icon beside the temperature, or above it. Automatic: beside on a top or bottom dock, above on a left or right dock.

settings.label: Each day
settings.description: What a day's cell looks like. Automatic: a column on a top or bottom dock, a line on a left or right dock.

choices.label: A column: day, icon, high, low
A tile: day over the icon, high over the low beside them

settings.label: The days go
settings.description: Where the day cells go: after the current conditions or under them. Automatic: after on a top or bottom dock, under on a left or right dock.

settings.label: Size of the whole slot
settings.description: Scales everything on a dock (a desktop widget fills its window instead). Default: 100.

settings.label: Size of the day cells
settings.description: Scales the day cells on their own, so the forecast can be larger than the current conditions. Default: 100.

settings.label: Space between days
settings.description: The gap between one day's cell and the next. Default: 6.

settings.label: Space before the days
settings.description: The gap between the current conditions and the first day. Default: 8.

settings.label: Hours in the curve
settings.description: How many hours from now the curve covers. Default: 12.

settings.label: Width of the curve
settings.description: The curve's width on the dock, scaled by the sizes below. Default: 120.

settings.label: Chance of rain as bars
settings.description: A bar under each hour with rain likely, as tall as its chance. On by default.

settings.label: Labels under the curve
settings.description: Small text under the curve: none, Now and the last hour, or those and the warmest (or coldest) hour ahead. Default: with the peak.

choices.label: Now, the last hour and the peak

settings.label: Line colour
settings.description: The curve in the text colour, the accent, or coloured by temperature (the scale's ends under Colours). Default: the text colour.

settings.label: On a left or right dock
settings.description: A side dock has no room for a curve: a thermometer from today's low to its high with a dot at the temperature now, or the high over the low as text. Default: thermometer.

settings.label: Tint of each chip
settings.description: What colours a day's chip: its high on the temperature scale (Colours below), its condition, the accent, or nothing. Default: temperature.

settings.label: Tint strength
settings.description: How strong the tint behind a chip is. Default: 25.

settings.label: Outline the chips
settings.description: A thin line in the tint around each chip. On by default.

settings.label: Corner radius of the chips
settings.description: Rounder corners as it grows; at its largest the chips are pills. Default: 30.

settings.label: Show the low in a chip
settings.description: Adds each day's low after its high on a top or bottom dock (a side dock's upright chips show the high only). On by default.

settings.label: Show the condition's name
settings.description: Writes the condition ("Partly cloudy") under the temperature. Off by default.

settings.label: Show the place under the temperature
settings.description: Writes the place's name under the temperature. Off by default.

settings.label: Show feels like
settings.description: Writes the apparent temperature ("Feels 20°") under the temperature. Off by default.

settings.label: Show today's high
settings.description: Adds today's highest temperature under the current one. Off by default.

settings.label: Show today's low
settings.description: Adds today's lowest temperature under the current one. Off by default.

settings.label: Day names
settings.description: How the days are named: Mon, M or Monday. Automatic: Mon in columns and tiles, M in lines.

settings.label: Call the first day "Today"
settings.description: The first day cell says Today instead of its weekday. On by default.

settings.label: High and low
settings.description: How a high and low pair is written on one line. Automatic: arrows under the temperature, a slash in a day cell.

settings.label: Icons
settings.description: The pictures of the conditions: ViberDock's filled glyphs, Lucide's line icons (lucide.dev, ISC licence), or Meteocons' coloured, animated icons (meteocons.com, MIT licence). Default: ViberDock.

settings.label: Animated icons
settings.description: Meteocons move: the sun's rays turn, clouds drift, rain falls. Windows' compositor runs the loops, so the dock itself stays idle. Off with reduce motion. On by default.

settings.label: Icon colours
settings.description: Coloured: a yellow sun and blue rain. Single colour: everything in the text colour (the ViberDock pack keeps its yellow sun; Meteocons are always coloured). Default: coloured.

settings.label: Compact (the icon only)
settings.description: The temperature and the text lines are left out; the popup still shows everything.

settings.label: Cold end of the scale
settings.description: The colour of a cold temperature: the Capsules' tint, the Trend's thermometer and its line coloured by temperature. Default: sky blue.

settings.label: Hot end of the scale
settings.description: The colour of a hot temperature; between the two ends the hue goes through green and yellow. Default: orange.

settings.label: The scale spans
settings.description: Fixed: the cold end is 0 °C (32 °F), the hot end 30 °C (86 °F). The days shown: from the lowest to the highest of them, so any week shows the whole range of colours. Default: fixed.

choices.label: The lowest to the highest shown

settings.label: Clicking the widget opens
settings.description: What a click does: open the forecast popup, open the widget's settings to choose the place, or nothing. Default: the forecast popup.

settings.label: Days in the popup
settings.description: How many days the popup's daily forecast lists. Default: 7.

settings.label: Hours in the popup's strip
settings.description: How many hours the popup's hourly strip covers. Default: 24.
